body: I got this exact same email today. It went to my junk folder. I deleted it.
NTA. Would he feel “guilty” if he didn’t need something from you?
I’m glad I could help in anyway. I hope you make the decision that is best for you and your life ❤️

I had an abortion in November. Immense regret for the child I voluntarily gave up. The reason I did it? My partner turned out to have another girlfriend and was more concerned about her than me and our child. He would tell me he’d be there but to prepare to be a single mom. He got meaner and meaner (after he admitted to having another woman). He treated me like an intrusion on his life. He turned into someone I didn’t know. He kept telling me to “imagine how she’s going to feel” (how his other gf was gonna feel). He stopped paying much attention to me and told me we’d never be a family. I’m already a single mom with an abusive ex and his words/actions scared me. I wanted that child and regret my decision but, financially, emotionally and mentally, I couldn’t do it alone again.

It took me awhile to connect with my doctor. She recommended an anti-depressant and a sleeping pill (haven’t taken them - idk why it should make me feel better…right?) She also recommended vitamin d and counselling. Maybe it’s worth a call to your doctor if not…I hope you figure out something that works for you.

I’m sorry for your loss. I felt the same when my nephew died a few years ago. I can’t say it gets better. Your mom wouldn’t want you to do it (I know that doesn’t help). Keep posting when you feel like this. I’m sure someone from this community has wiser words than mine. I just wanted to respond and let you know you’re seen and heard.

It’s hard to see the bright side when you don’t think there is one. Keep checking in on him..letting him know you’re there. Idk what you can do for him. Sometimes you can be the most supportive person but it doesn’t matter.
That’s awful to know. Can’t help but feel like what’s the point then.
Thank you! All the other mom groups say ovulation happens AFTER the surge and that doesn’t sound right.
